# Rubber Duck — GitHub project summary

Rubber Duck is a static React/WebMCP study companion. It uses a structured step canvas and a Siko-like graduated hint ladder, but enforces the ladder through live WebMCP tool registration: an agent cannot discover stronger help until the learner spends a token.

Run with `pnpm install && pnpm dev`. The full challenge runbook, tool table, WebMCP setup, and license are in the repository root README.
